subject: Intro + Dedicated capacity demo request — throughput & latency targets

Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — dedicated capacity for real-time routing

Hi Karthik,

We signed up for Redwood last week and ran some quick tests in the hosted sandbox. We're evaluating Dedicated capacity for a production rollout across our last-mile routing product. High-level constraints:~
- Steady-state ~30 requests/sec (text-generation prompts) across 3 regions~
- P50 latency target under ~200ms for 512-token responses~
- Occasional burst windows up to ~120 req/sec for 2–5 minutes during dispatch spikes~

We'd like a technical demo focused on throughput/latency and to understand autoscaling/burst behavior. Can we book a 60-minute session early next week? I'm in PDT. Availability: Tue/Wed 9–11am or Thu 1–4pm.

Thanks — happy to share any traffic patterns or sample prompts ahead of time.

Emma Lockwood
Sr. Engineering Manager, Helio Logistics

procurement@helio-logistics.com

Team — forwarding Emma's inbound with the high-level asks. TL;DR: Helio needs Dedicated for near real-time generation (p50 <200ms at 30 req/sec steady, bursts to 120 req/sec). They want a 60-min demo with a live throughput run on Tue 05/11 at 10:00 PDT. They will provide traffic snapshot + completed sizing form (attached).

Proposed agenda (60 min):~
- 5m intros & scope~
- 15m architecture & model selection (Monica)~
- 25m live load test + latency/ops metrics (Monica + Rishi)~
- 10m autoscale/burst behavior, caching, fallback policies (Rishi)~
- 5m next steps & procurement path (Karthik)

Questions for you both before the demo:~
- Which model variants should we stage for the test? They hinted at a mid-sized open model and a 13B family fallback.
- Can we run a synthetic burst to 150 req/sec for 30s to validate headroom? (They asked about bursts to 120, but I'd like a little headroom.)

Please confirm availability and who will present which slide.

Thanks,
Karthik

I'll own the 25m load test (Monica) and Rishi can cover autoscale, commit sizing, and SLAs. Proposed presenter split: Monica (architecture + test), Rishi (autoscale & pricing), Karthik (next steps & procurement).

I'll send a calendar invite to Emma for Tue 2027-05-11 10:00 PDT and include the sizing form + SLA PDF.
